property_summary: For any inputs, when a callee invoked by C.transfer reverts with arbitrary revert data, C.transfer should propagate that exact revert data (so a try/catch that captures the revert bytes from the call to C.transfer yields the same bytes as the callee's revert); the mutant replaces an unchecked revert propagation with require(..., "external call failed") and thus for some inputs the propagated revert data will be the fixed message instead of the callee's original revert data.
change_summary: Remove the revert on failed external call and replace with a require so failures revert with a message (semantic difference in revert data exposed externally).
